Perchta Day (Perchtenlauf)

A Cozy Perchta Day at Home

Embrace the ancient Alpine spirit of Frau Perchta from the comfort of your home. This agenda helps you honor the guardian of hearth and spinning, banishing winter's gloom with warmth, good food, and festive traditions.

  1. Morning

    Welcome the Hearth's Guardian

    Begin your Perchta Day by tidying your home, especially the hearth area, to honor Frau Perchta's role as a protector of the household. Light a candle to symbolize warmth and welcome.

  2. Mid-Morning

    Bake Sweet Offerings

    Prepare traditional poppy-seed pastries and sweet krapfen. These treats are offered to both the masked Perchten figures and revelers in Alpine villages, filling your home with delightful aromas.

    Recipes: Poppy Seed Pastries · Traditional Austrian Krapfen

  3. Afternoon

    Craft Hearty Dumplings

    Start making the hearty dumplings, a staple offering for the Perchten. This comforting, hands-on activity is perfect for a wintry day and forms the centerpiece of your festive meal.

    Recipes: Chinese Pork and Cabbage Dumplings (Jiaozi)

  4. Late Afternoon

    Brew Festive Beverages

    As the day progresses, warm up a batch of mulled wine and prepare a milky punch. These traditional drinks are perfect for warding off the chill and sharing good cheer.

    Recipes: Traditional Mulled Wine (Glühwein) · Warming Milky Punch

  5. Sundown

    Symbolic Banishment of Darkness

    Mimic the Perchtenlauf by symbolically chasing away darkness and welcoming protection. You can do this by ringing bells, playing festive music, or taking a short walk with a lantern around your yard.

  6. Evening

    A Traditional Perchta Feast

    Gather to enjoy your homemade dumplings, poppy-seed pastries, and krapfen. This meal is an offering of gratitude and a celebration of the season's bounty and protection.

    Recipes: Chinese Pork and Cabbage Dumplings (Jiaozi) · Poppy Seed Pastries · Traditional Austrian Krapfen

  7. Late Evening

    Cozy Winter Reflection

    Wind down your Perchta Day with a warm cup of milky punch or mulled wine. Reflect on the protection and renewal that Frau Perchta brings to your home during the Twelve Nights.

    Recipes: Warming Milky Punch · Traditional Mulled Wine (Glühwein)

May your home be blessed with warmth and protection this Perchta Day!
